description:
A coaster brake La Roca Build..heavy on the rowdy.

Built on an XL La Roca…same one as I (5’8”) rode on the Arizona Trail with the stem flipped around. Long wheelbase for some extra stability which is nice for a loaded single track tourer while the short seat tube allows for a long dropper and whatever inseam rider chooses it. Let me know your height and inseam and we can dial in fit.

A 1.5 degree Gold Works Slackset makes it even rowdier. Some green in the i9 stem and Red in the Bomber z2 fork graphics give it a subtle rasta vibe.

Our souped out shimano coaster hub with all the upgrades… monē torque arm, HD nice nuts, custom boost finned spacers. Not picutred, but included, is our coaster cooling fins. Industry 9 front hub hand laced with our raw brass nips to velocity blunt 35 hoops.

WTB rubber, KS suicide droper to keep our carbon lightbars clean.

Is there a doper more unique single speed mountain bike on the market? tough to say…but this one can’t be far off.
